title: Compare two delivery choices
prompt:
The reader has no earlier conversation.
Compare these choices and recommend one for the owner’s stated need. Explain the tradeoff without inventing native support or permission changes.

Fixed synthetic input (not a report about real Overseer behavior):
- Need: apply optional writing guidance on the next turn while preserving the current conversation.
- Choice A: use the qualified fixture message channel. It supports the next turn and adds 420 bytes to that turn’s prompt.
- Choice B: use a proposed native instruction channel. It is unverified and may require a new thread.
- Neither choice changes the approval policy; the proposed native channel has not been tested.
